meta.name: geomaster
meta.description: Comprehensive geospatial science skill covering remote sensing, GIS, spatial analysis, machine learning for earth observation, and 30+ scientific domains. Supports satellite imagery processing (Sentinel, Landsat, MODIS, SAR, hyperspectral), vector and raster data operations, spatial statistics, point cloud processing, network analysis, cloud-native workflows (STAC, COG, Planetary Computer), and 8 programming languages (Python, R, Julia, JavaScript, C++, Java, Go, Rust) with 500+ code examples. Use for remote sensing workflows, GIS analysis, spatial ML, Earth observation data processing, terrain analysis, hydrological modeling, marine spatial analysis, atmospheric science, and any geospatial computation task.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 处理多源遥感影像和地理数据，产出空间统计与环境研究成果
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是地学研究者或GIS从业者,常处理卫星影像与空间数据。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are in geospatial science and regularly handle satellite and spatial datasets.

howto.what: 让 Claude 能处理地理空间数据：读卫星影像与矢量图，计算 NDVI 等指数，做地形/网络分析与影像分类，从 STAC 等云端取数，并给出代码示例。
howto.when: 当你提到遥感影像、地图数据或空间计算等地理任务时，此技能会触发并给出对应的代码和步骤。

say.text: 帮我用云量小于 20% 的哨兵二号影像计算这片区域的 NDVI。
say.note: 会给出读取影像并计算的代码。

say.text: 对这份 GeoJSON 和点数据做空间连接，再按区域统计一下。
say.note: 会示范 GeoPandas 的空间连接与分组统计。

say.text: 把洛杉矶街道网络下载下来，规划一条最快路线。
say.note: 会写 OSMnx 与 NetworkX 找最短路径的代码。

howto.what_en: Gives Claude the ability to handle geospatial data: read satellite images and vector files, compute indices like NDVI, run terrain/network analyses and image classification, query cloud-native services like STAC, and output code examples.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention remote-sensing images, map data, or spatial computation; it then supplies matching code and steps.

say_en.text: Compute NDVI from a Sentinel-2 scene with cloud cover under 20%.
say_en.note: Shows code to read the image and calculate NDVI.

say_en.text: Spatially join this GeoJSON and point data, then get per-zone statistics.
say_en.note: Uses GeoPandas sjoin and per-zone stats.

say_en.text: Download Los Angeles street network and plan a fastest route.
say_en.note: Uses OSMnx and NetworkX for a shortest-path example.
